data.current_summary: Retrieve an allowlisted governance-discovery placement and short-lived attribution token.
data.current_description: Records the opaque placement, a bounded retrieval identifier, the retrieval kind, a timestamp, and an expiry. The discovery service at beacon.getmarrow.ai also records one of four fixed automation classes derived from bot-verification signals or the User-Agent header. Raw prompts, source code, credentials, personal data, network addresses, and User-Agent text are not stored in discovery metrics. A salted hash of the caller network address is kept temporarily in a separate rate-limit counter.
data.description_suggestion: Retrieves an allowlisted governance-discovery placement and returns a short-lived attribution token. Input: placement_id (path parameter) identifying the target placement. Output: placement record with opaque identifier, retrieval kind, timestamp, expiry, and automation class derived from bot-verification signals. Side effects: Records placement retrieval metadata and maintains temporary rate-limit counter using salted network address hash. Note: Raw prompts, source code, credentials, personal data, and User-Agent text are not stored in discovery metrics.
